rows.jyutping: gung1 gung6 gaau1 tung1 gung1 geoi6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for public transport when referring to the buses, trains, ferries, and other services people use.

example.english: I take public transport to work every day instead of driving.
example.traditional: 我平日返工都係搭公共交通工具，唔使自己揸車。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 jat6 faan1 gung1 dou1 hai6 daap3 gung1 gung6 gaau1 tung1 gung1 geoi6 m4 sai2 zi6 gei2 zaa1 ce1

rows.note: Use this more generally for public transport as a transport system or category, especially in official or informational contexts.

example.english: The government encourages people to use public transport more to reduce road congestion.
example.traditional: 政府鼓勵市民多用公共交通，以減少道路擠塞。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 gu2 lai6 si5 man4 do1 jung6 gung1 gung6 gaau1 tung1 ji5 gaam2 siu2 dou6 lou6 zai1 sak1
